text:
Maya: Quick check — console observability roadmap milestone: retention change and tracing hooks. We have a Thu EOD retention milestone; need owners, any blockers, and PR links. Also curious whether tracing hooks for the alpha rollout are still on track. cc @Samir @Jorge @Li
Samir: Blocked on infra side due to the sampling config change review. PR up but needs infra approval: will follow up today. ETA tomorrow for unblock.
Jorge: Dashboards in staging look good. Error-analysis view needs normalized error codes which depends on schema change (blocked until PR lands). Not ready for prod yet.
Li: I merged the temporary retention config to staging yesterday (retention=90d -> 30d as a canary). Migration plan is in the wiki: https://wiki.redwood/obs/retention-plan. No infra blockers from my side.
Maya: Thanks — can folks drop PR links here? Also need a rollback plan for retention if storage spikes.
Samir: PRs: infra#4521 https://gh/rd/infra/pull/4521 (sampling), schema#4599 https://gh/rd/platform/pull/4599 (error schema). I'll ping infra on today's stand.
Jorge: I'll open a lightweight regression PR for error-normalization tests today.
Zach: Heads-up: retention reductions can cause cost dashboards to move unexpectedly when we change aggregation windows. Ops will flag if cost delta >20%.
OpsBot: deploybot: retention-config applied to staging at 2412348000, job-id rcn-1187
Li: Proposal: canary retention in prod on Tue for 1% of traffic, monitor for 48h. I can schedule the canary run and attach the dashboard links.
Maya: Sounds good. Action items: Samir follow infra PR review, Jorge open error-reg PR, Li schedule 1% canary, I'll update the roadmap doc and ping security for KMS/keys check. Post PR links + blockers here so I can close the milestone. Thx :thumbsup:
Samir: Pinged infra; will update thread later today (reacted :eyes:)
Jorge: PR opened: https://gh/rd/platform/pull/4605 — tests passing in CI, will add reviewers.
OpsBot: alert: cost-monitor will start observing canary on 2412351600
Li: Canary scheduled Tue 09:00 PT. Runbook + dashboards: https://dash.redwood/obs/canary/rcn-1187
Maya: :thumbsup: closing this async check-in. If anything pops, tag #oncall or DM.
